title: Public records request – duplicate of prior Ponomarenko request (MuckRock #175385)

communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Ohio Open Records Law, I hereby request the following records:

To the Records Room:

Under the Ohio Public Records Act, R.C. 149.43, I request copies of the records the Parma Police Department prepared in response to an earlier request about Matthew Ponomarenko and the March 2021 death of his four-year-old son. That request was submitted October 27, 2024 and published on MuckRock as #175385 (https://www.muckrock.com/foi/parma-25408/foia-request-for-case-related-materials-175385/), and your department issued a $1.25 fee notice for it.

Specifically, the same prepared set:
1. body-worn and dash camera video;
2. 911 and police radio audio;
3. incident and investigation reports;
4. any recorded interview of Matthew Ponomarenko included in that set.

Because these records were already located and reviewed for the prior requester, I ask for a duplicate without new search or redaction. Under city policy, emailed electronic files are provided at no charge, so I ask for email or download-link delivery (an expiring link is fine). If any cost applies, I will pay up to the same $1.25; please tell me first if it would exceed $25.

If only part is available now, please send that part. If anything released before is withheld, please cite the specific exception under R.C. 149.43.

Thank you.

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 10 business days.

Sincerely,

Jordan Bradley

title: Public records request – duplicate of prepared Pavlons/Pahl A/V release (MuckRock #198763)

communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Wisconsin Open Records Act, I hereby request the following records:

To the Records Custodian:

Under Wisconsin's Public Records Law, Wis. Stat. §§ 19.31–19.39, I request copies of the audio/video records your office prepared in response to an earlier request about the August 2022 homicide of Stephanie Pavlons (suspect Matthew Pahl), submitted November 27, 2025 and published on MuckRock as #198763 (https://www.muckrock.com/foi/waukesha-county-8641/stephanie-pavlons-matthew-pahl-case-waukesha-county-sheriff-198763/), for which your office issued an $11.00 fee notice.

Specifically, the same prepared set:
1. body-worn camera from the body discovery along Golf Road, Delafield;
2. the 911 call from the construction workers;
3. surveillance video collected from Willow Park Apartments and Orthopedic Associates of Wisconsin;
4. recorded interviews of Matthew Pahl.

Because these records were already located and reviewed for the prior requester, I ask for a duplicate of that release without new search or redaction. Under § 19.35(3), the cost should be the actual reproduction cost. I'm happy to pay the same $11.00, or nothing for an electronic download link. If the total would exceed $25, please tell me first.

Electronic delivery (email or download link, including an expiring one) is preferred. If part is ready now, please send that part. If anything released before is withheld, please state the reasons in writing as § 19.35(4)(b) requires.

Thank you.

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 10 business days.

Sincerely,

Jordan Bradley

title: Public records request – duplicate of PRR 24-5241 (Gaines homicide, report 210012415)

communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Ohio Open Records Law, I hereby request the following records:

To the Public Records Unit:

Under the Ohio Public Records Act, R.C. 149.43, I request copies of the records your unit processed under public records request 24-5241 (submitted October 27, 2024; published on MuckRock as #175378: https://www.muckrock.com/foi/columbus-323/foia-request-for-case-related-materials-175378/). They concern the January 6, 2021 homicide of David Gaines on E. Hudson Street (report 210012415; suspect Dontrell Jaynes).

Under 24-5241 your unit released report 210012415 and two radio recordings (2021-01-06, Ch107 and Ch94), and issued payment instructions for $18.20 for the remaining media. I request:
1. the video/audio covered by those $18.20 payment instructions, as prepared;
2. report 210012415 and the two radio recordings, as released.

Because this media was already produced and redacted under 24-5241, I ask for a duplicate copy without new production or redaction time, so at no more than the same $18.20. I will prepay that amount. If the cost would exceed $25, please send an estimate first.

Electronic delivery (email or download link, including an expiring one) is preferred. If part is available now, please release that part. If anything released before is now withheld, please cite the specific exception under R.C. 149.43(B)(3).

Thank you.

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 10 business days.

Sincerely,

Jordan Bradley

title: Duplicate of prior request 20250181 – Rodriguez-Sigala homicide records

communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Nevada Public Records Act, I hereby request the following records:

Under the Nevada Public Records Act, NRS Chapter 239, I request electronic copies of the records the Sparks Police Department previously processed under public records request no. 20250181 (submitted January 13, 2025, completed March 18, 2025; published on MuckRock as #179678: https://www.muckrock.com/foi/sparks-8973/foia-request-for-case-related-materials-brian-rodriguez-sigala-179678/).

The records concern the 2021 homicide investigation that resulted in Brian Rodriguez-Sigala's conviction and 70-year sentence (case adjudicated). Specifically:
1. all records released under 20250181;
2. any body-worn camera, in-car video and 911/dispatch audio released or prepared under 20250181;
3. recorded interviews of Brian Rodriguez-Sigala, if released or prepared.

Because these records were already located and redacted for the prior requester, I ask for the same release as a duplicate, without new search or redaction. Under NRS 239.052 that should be at no charge, or actual media cost only. If any fee would exceed $50, please send an estimate first. I will respond promptly.

Electronic delivery (email or download link, including an expiring one) is preferred. If only part is ready, please send it now. If anything released before is now withheld, please cite the specific statutory basis (NRS 239.0107(1)(d)).

Thank you.

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 5 business days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

Jordan Bradley
